Medicine Brand Cross-Reference 药品商品名跨国定位
Search About ENES中文

About 关于本站

One job: turn a brand name into the actual substance, and say how sure we are. 这里只有一件事：把商品名定位到成分，并说明它到底有多可信。

Three rules 三条底线

  1. A brand name is not a primary key. 商品名不是主键。 Every query returns a set of candidates; identity is pinned by country × form × strength × active ingredient. 唯一性由「国家 × 剂型 × 规格 × 活性成分」锁定。
  2. Collisions are derived, not annotated. 碰撞自动推导。 When one name hangs off different ingredients, the site flags “same name, different drug” automatically.
  3. No dosing advice. 不给用药建议。 Identification and “not interchangeable” warnings only — no dose conversion, no substitution recommendations.

US 美国: openFDA NDC Directory (US Government public data; brand_name + active_ingredients).
UK 英国: NHSBSA dm+d, Release 10.2.0, under the Open Government Licence v3.0 — attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Appliance/device entries were filtered out.
Spain 西班牙: AEMPS CIMA (Centro de Información online de Medicamentos), nregistro + vtm + dosis + atcs; Spanish generic names carry the manufacturer (e.g. “Omeprazol Cinfa”), which is how the pack is labelled. 西班牙按 VTM 归成分，西语名与英文 INN 共用同一 substance_id。
Mexico 墨西哥: COFEPRIS «Registros Sanitarios de Medicamentos Alopáticos Expedidos», 26 annual PDFs 2001–2026, plus the prórrogas (renewal) lists that carry 1,040 older registrations granted before 2001 — 10,878 records in total. Status is derived, not given: revocados / cancelados → withdrawn; an expiry date in the past → discontinued; no expiry column at all (the 2001–2010 files) → unknown, we do not pretend either way. The lists carry no strength column: strengths are back-filled from the ISSSTE procurement catalogue and the PROFECO price survey (both CC BY 4.0), only where the value is unambiguous — so a blank strength in Mexico is expected, not a bug.
Australia 澳洲: PBS Schedule API v3 (Department of Health), schedule 4751 effective 1 October 2026 — 15,073 item × brand rows, 5,452 products after collapsing the same brand/strength/pack that appears under several restriction codes. The API's copyright notice explicitly permits use and redistribution as long as the statement is retained: Copyright (c) 2024 Department of Health, Commonwealth of Australia. PBS lists only subsidised medicines, so OTC brands (Panadol, Nurofen, Gaviscon) are absent by design; the full register (TGA ARTG) publishes no bulk extract and blocks automated access. Stoma/incontinence appliances (program R1) are filtered out.
澳洲走 PBS 官方 API，不是抓网页：PBS 网页的版权只允许个人参考，API 才明确允许再发布。 覆盖面只到「享受补贴的药品」，所以 OTC 品牌查不到；TGA 的 ARTG 才是全量在册，但没有批量文件。 R1 造口/失禁用品（敷料、绷带）已按 dm+d 滤器械的同一逻辑排除。
China 中国: 国家医保局「医保药品分类与代码数据库」, 2024-01-05 snapshot — 234,370 catalogue rows (the same batch is a 19,531-page PDF), of which the 135,667 chemical-drug rows load as 135,348 products. Chinese generic names are mapped onto the same English substance_ids the other markets use, through a hand-built 中文→INN table (~1,080 entries) plus an ATC-4 lookup that only fires when that ATC class is unambiguous; the residue sits on China-only substances that a later pass can map. 中成药 (98,703 rows, 42 real brand names) is excluded on purpose. 商品名 exists for only 13% of rows, so most Chinese products are reachable by generic name rather than by brand.

Why “same name, different drug” happens 为什么会有同名不同药

The same trademark is held by different companies in different markets, and the formula can differ completely. Verified examples: US Tylenol is single-ingredient acetaminophen 500 mg, while China 泰诺 is a four-ingredient cold medicine and the single-ingredient product is 泰诺林; US Benadryl is diphenhydramine, UK Benadryl is acrivastine; US Gaviscon is an aluminium/magnesium antacid, UK Gaviscon is an alginate raft.

Known gaps 已知缺口

  • China now carries 135,348 chemical-drug registrations, but ~9% of them resolve only to a China-only substance (no English INN yet), and China's ATC is stored at level 4 — these products carry ATC-4, not ATC-5. 中成药 is not loaded.
    中国已入库 13.5 万条化学药，但约 9% 只能落到 CN 专属成分（暂无英文 INN）， ATC 只到第 4 级；中成药未收录。
  • Strength equivalence stops at level D1 (same salt form). Salt-base conversion (D2) and bioavailability judgement (D3) are not implemented.
    剂量只做到同型对应，盐基折算与生物利用度判定未做。
  • Mexico has no strength in the regulator's bulk lists; only 29% of products could be back-filled from public catalogues, and no brand-level bulk source exists.
    墨西哥官方清单没有浓度列，只有 29% 的产品能从公开目录回填。
  • The Mexican files only list registrations issued from 2001 onward; the renewal lists recover 1,040 older ones, but anything never renewed is still missing.
    墨西哥清单只含 2001 年起新批的注册，续期清单补回 1,040 条老药，其余仍缺。
  • ATC codes are mostly missing.
    ATC 编码大部分缺失。

Stats 统计：359,200 products · 10,904 substances · 102,053 name keys · 24,652 names flagged “same name, different drug”.
